title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-20
lineage: AUD: reel master > CDR > EAC > CDR, 46:19
source: recorded by Marty Weinberg on a 5" Uher open-reel deck.

ai_review.summary: Atmospheric audience capture that divides listeners, but the show shines with a Phil‑Jerry tour de force.
ai_review.review: The recording offers an immersive, audience‑sourced sound that some fans love for its sense of space, while others find it muffled and inferior to a clean soundboard. Musically the concert is praised for strong playing by Jerry Garcia and Phil Lesh, with the unusual inclusion of “Mama Tried” noted as a historical footnote.

ai_rating.rationale: Show performance is highly praised (≈4.5/5) but recording quality receives mixed feedback, averaging around fair (≈2.5/5); weighted combination yields ~3.9.

recording_quality.technical_notes: One reviewer lauds the atmospheric capture, another calls it the worst source, describing a muffled “cardboard tube” sound; overall opinions on clarity are split.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on pacing; reviewers focus on individual performances rather than set structure.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as a tour‑de‑force alongside Phil; strong guitar work noted.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for a tour‑de‑force performance with Jerry.
